alex: noted. Any DB migrations in this one?

jamie: collecting diagnostics and core dumps, uploading artifacts to S3: s3://redwood-artifacts/releases/1785007777/diagnostics.tar.gz

deploy-bot: Canary rolled back successfully. Full rollout paused; release tag retained but not promoted.
taylor: I'll open a follow-up in eng-runtime with the trace and heap dumps. Suggest adding checksum + canary readiness gate to the pipeline.

morgan: thanks all — will re-run validations once fix merged. :thumbsup:
alex: we should also add an automated config sanity check before tag promotion. Filing a task after incident closed.
